situation: Founder-led 22-person job shop; 30% of HN 24 mm shaft (24.37, cheaper than Rottaler's 24.92) and 100% of the HN lantern. Bidder in P05 HX pump-shaft RFQ (doc:20260923-70210-P05, rfq:6000000305, 4,200 pc/yr, SOP 2027-03). The owner admits he has not tracked material and energy prices since the 2022 peak - the office manager does the costing (doc:20260908-70210-M1), so his quote likely embeds peak-era costs. Second shift on hold since spring, can take parts at short notice (doc:20260722-70210-M2); sees Hollerau as an important reference customer (doc:20260910-70210-M3). Quality amber and slipping (sc:70210@2026Q3: OTD 80.8%, ppm 1863).
